lineage.strategy: Acquire current primary regulatory operating and cash-flow evidence.

observations.fact: Mobileye reported first-half 2026 revenue of $1.066B, up 13% year over year, while operating cash flow was $210M versus $322M a year earlier; it paid $591M net cash for Mentee Robotics in February 2026.

risks.risk: Operating cash generation declined year over year while acquisition and investment outflows increased materially; management also expects 2026 capex above 2025.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental returns from Mentee Robotics and the higher 2026 capex program are not yet demonstrated in this filing.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed growth/cash/deployment evidence; Alpha should map values into Methodology 1.0 without Scout assigning a score.
